finding.packet_premise: the sorted child snapshot 00AA5A00 feeds the GUI draw queue and geOrder is the key
finding.actual: both halves are wrong. 00AA5A00 is an alphabetical (_stricmp) snapshot of a widget's children built only for the reflection walk 00AAAED0 and rebuilt on every call. geOrder has no literal anywhere in the image, so the runtime never reads it. GUI draw order is the float RenderOrder on a cGuiLayer, used as the key of an MSVC std::multimap<float, cGuiCameraStore*> at manager+8h that 00AA45A0 walks ascending.
